info.title: API.SH: Shazam
info.description: The Shazam API from API.SH: public Shazam data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Shazam artist top songs and other lists
get.description:
An artist's top songs (or, with `list`, albums, singles, music videos, appears-on, compilations, live albums or similar artists), paged. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/shazam-artist-top-tracks

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Artist id or a Shazam / Apple Music artist link.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: top-songs (default), albums, singles, music-videos, appears-on, compilations, live-albums, similar-artists.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (top songs up to 20, others up to 100).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Start position (default 0).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter store country for titles, links and availability (default US).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Shazam charts (global, country, city, genre, viral)
get.description:
The current Shazam chart: global or a country's top chart, its viral chart, a genre chart (global or per country), a city chart, or a global radio-spins genre chart. Each track: rank, id, title, artist, album, composer, genres, duration, release date, ISRC, explicit flag, preview audio, artwork, Apple Music and Shazam links. The chart's name and last update come with it. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page. Every chart id is listed by /shazam/v1/charts/list.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/shazam-charts

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: A country code or name with Shazam charts (US, GB, DE, IN, BR...) or `global` (default).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: top (default), viral, genre, radio_spins (global only) or city.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Genre for type=genre or radio_spins, e.g. pop, hip-hop-rap, dance, latin, k-pop (see /shazam/v1/charts/list).

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City for a city chart, e.g. chicago, london, paris (see /shazam/v1/charts/list).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Tracks per page, up to 200 (default 50).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Start position (default 0).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
All the charts Shazam publishes: the global top and viral charts, global genre and radio-spins charts, and for each country its top, viral and genre charts and its city charts, with the ids and names to pass to /shazam/v1/charts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/shazam-charts-list

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search songs, artists, albums, music videos and playlists by name, as the Shazam search box does. Songs come with ISRC, preview audio, artwork and Shazam links; artists with genres, image and Shazam link. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null when no type has more results.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/shazam-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Song, artist or album name.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated: songs, artists, albums, music-videos, playlists (default songs,artists).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per type, up to 25 (default 10).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Start position (default 0).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter store country for titles, links and availability (default US).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Everything on a song's Shazam page: Shazam count, popular segment (where in the song people Shazam it most), audio analysis (BPM, energy, danceability, valence, acousticness, melodicness), label, language, time-synced lyrics by section plus the plain lyrics text, writers, music video, the artist's top songs on Shazam and similar songs; with the catalogue record (title, artist, album, composer, genres, duration, release date, ISRC, preview, artwork, album details, artists, music videos).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/shazam-track

parameters.name: id

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter store country for titles, links and availability (default US).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
